column1: # Curated: the passenger-car fleet of each country. cars_per_1000 = passenger cars (with SUVs, pickups and passenger vans used as cars) in use per 1,000 people, rounded from OICA vehicles in use, the European Commission's and national registers and the WHO road safety report's registered vehicles; mean_age = mean age of the car fleet in years (ACEA, S&P Global Mobility, national registers; estimates where none is published); annual_km = average distance a car is driven in a year (Eurostat, ODYSSEE-MURE, national travel surveys; estimates elsewhere); markets = which model ranges are sold there, in order of preference (see doc/data.md); automatic = share of new cars of a model year with an automatic gearbox, as year:share anchors interpolated between (curated from national sales statistics and makers' figures). Small territories are estimates from their neighbours and imports.
